_comment: Project-level Claude Code settings for MRR AI, committed so every Claude Code session in this repository gets them. Extends each user's ~/.claude/settings.json.
_hipaa_note: This project handles raw medical record content sent to model providers (Gemini on Vertex by default; OpenAI or a self-hosted vLLM server by configuration). Stricter PHI review required on all PRs.
_hooks_note: Stop: .claude/hooks/docs-reminder.sh reminds an agent once, before it finishes, about READMEs, CLAUDE.md files and pages its code changes may have made wrong. See docs/how-to/work-on-these-docs.md.
